mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follow WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND following_id = #{followingId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, u1.name AS follower_name, u1.number AS follower_number, u1.email AS follower_email, u1.age AS follower_age, u1.sex AS follower_sex, u1.avatar AS follower_avatar, u2.name AS following_name, u2.number AS following_number, u2.email AS following_email, u2.age AS following_age, u2.sex AS following_sex, u2.avatar AS following_avatar FROM follow f LEFT JOIN user u1 ON f.follower_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON f.following_id = u2.id WHERE f.follower_id = #{followerId} AND f.following_id = #{followingId}

SELECT f.*, u1.name AS follower_name, u1.number AS follower_number, u1.email AS follower_email, u1.age AS follower_age, u1.sex AS follower_sex, u1.avatar AS follower_avatar, u2.name AS following_name, u2.number AS following_number, u2.email AS following_email, u2.age AS following_age, u2.sex AS following_sex, u2.avatar AS following_avatar FROM follow f LEFT JOIN user u1 ON f.follower_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON f.following_id = u2.id WHERE f.following_id = #{followingId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
